prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Wen Yang from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the young warrior who turned alone and drove back hundreds. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish.

World (fixed): year 2190, the Wei Federation in orbit: a navy-black orbital fortress and capital-ship fleet above a cold blue planet, starfields and a distant sun, hard white floodlights on armored hulls. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a steel whip-sword, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): glossy jet-black hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Rank (fixed): she is a famed war general — her costume must read battlefield might at first glance: imposing, richly worked armour and cloth with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Her original face is a compact soft heart with a short midface, naturally open turquoise eyes, a small straight nose and softly full lips. Glossy jet-black hair is a chin-length asymmetric bob with a clean diagonal fringe. Her expression is a composed challenging gaze. Choose costume shape 3: several rigid jointed armour plates flaring from the waist like a skirt, with the legs showing between them. Build her abrupt solo about-turn into overlapping radial hip plates that fold backward in a reverse spiral, matched by concentric interlocking pauldrons; richly engraved silver-edged navy and black armour with ivory mechanical inserts, clearly thick hard surfaces, joints, vents and cyan glow lines. No cloth. Deliberate deep neckline and bare shoulder gaps while intimate areas remain covered. She holds one continuous high-tech steel whip-sword with alloy articulated segments and cyan emitters in one hand, blade kept entirely clear to her side; the other hand rests visibly at her hip. Natural balanced three-quarter stance looking toward viewer. Empty navy-black orbital fortress command causeway with starfield windows and distant capital ships, luminous cold white and blue light, no other figures or animals.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a far-future setting only — no traditional East-Asian architecture, pagodas or tiled roofs; no hanzi; no logo or watermark.
